# PulseMotion TV — AI Pose & Fitness Coach for Amazon Fire TV

> Next-Generation Interactive AI Fitness Coach running 100% on-device on Amazon Fire TV (Silk Browser) & Web. Zero cloud streaming, zero latency, maximum privacy.

## Canonical Resources

- [Live Application Preview](https://pulsemotion-firetv.netlify.app/): Official production deployment of PulseMotion TV running on-device computer vision and speech synthesis.
- [GitHub Source Repository](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/pulsemotion-firetv): Open-source repository containing TypeScript codebase, biomechanical classifiers, and build configuration.
- [Project Documentation](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/pulsemotion-firetv#readme): Comprehensive guide covering Fire TV Silk Browser setup, remote control keycodes, and WebAssembly SIMD acceleration.
- [MIT License](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/pulsemotion-firetv/blob/main/LICENSE): Permissive open-source license governing usage, distribution, and commercial rights.
- [Privacy Policy & On-Device Processing](https://pulsemotion-firetv.netlify.app/#privacy): Detailed privacy commitment confirming zero camera video streaming, local-only landmark analysis, and complete data sovereignty.

## Core Value Proposition

PulseMotion TV transforms any living room with an Amazon Fire TV Stick into an intelligent personal gym. By executing Google MediaPipe Pose via WebAssembly SIMD and WebGL 2.0 GPU hardware acceleration, the application tracks 33 skeletal body landmarks at sustained 60 FPS without uploading video frames to external servers.

## Key Capabilities

1. **100% On-Device Pose Analysis**:
   - 33 3D skeletal landmarks computed in real-time (< 35 ms end-to-end latency).
   - Real-time joint angle calculation using 3-point trigonometric dot products (arccos).
   - 5 calibrated biomechanical exercises: Deep Squats, Jumping Jacks, High Knees Sprint, Yoga Tree Pose, and Lateral Arm Raises.

2. **Hands-Free Multi-Modal Voice Control**:
   - Web Speech Recognition API with asymmetric debounce cooldown (3,500 ms for exercise switching, 850 ms for actions).
   - Live freeze and resume: say "Pause" or "Stop" to freeze the timer, rep counter, and synthetic kinematic simulator in mid-frame; say "Start" to resume.
   - Hands-free privacy killswitch: say "Stop listening" / "Wyłącz mikrofon" to shut down speech recognition, re-activatable via remote key 'V'.

3. **10-Foot Living Room TV Experience**:
   - Overscan-safe layout with 5% safe-area padding for 720p, 1080p, and 4K UHD.
   - High-contrast emerald focus rings (`ring-4 ring-emerald-400`) visible from 3+ meters.
   - Full D-Pad spatial navigation mapped to Fire TV remote keycodes (DPAD_UP, DPAD_DOWN, DPAD_LEFT, DPAD_RIGHT, DPAD_CENTER).
   - On-screen virtual remote simulator for rapid desktop testing.

4. **Synthetic AI Pose Simulator**:
   - Built-in deterministic kinematic landmark playback engine.
   - Enables full judging, testing, and UI evaluation without requiring a physical camera.

5. **Audible Voice Coach**:
   - Web Speech Synthesis API providing spoken rep counts, pace cues, and form correction prompts in real-time.
   - Fully bilingual (English `en-US` and Polish `pl-PL`).

## Tech Stack & Architecture

- [React 19 & TypeScript](https://react.dev/): Modern frontend core with strict typing and functional component hierarchy.
- [Vite 6 Build System](https://vitejs.dev/): Ultra-fast modern web application bundling with automated asset optimization.
- [Tailwind CSS v4](https://tailwindcss.com/): Responsive utility styling tailored for 10-foot TV overscan and mobile devices.
- [Google MediaPipe Pose Solution](https://developers.google.com/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker): High-performance on-device pose estimation executing via WASM SIMD and WebGL 2.0.
- [Web Speech API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Speech_API): Native browser voice command recognition and real-time audio coach synthesis.
- [Lucide React](https://lucide.dev/): Lightweight, accessible SVG iconography.
